edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _feeAddrWallet in the ad-hoc privilege require, so caller identity controls fee administration.
setFeeRate can only be executed when msg.sender equals the fee wallet, allowing that wallet to arbitrarily change the swap fee rate.
manualswap is gated by the _feeAddrWallet comparison and can drain the contract token balance into a swap.
manualsend is gated by the _feeAddrWallet comparison and forwards the whole contract ETH balance.
The onlyOwner modifier derives the caller from _msgSender(), making ownership the sole gate for administrative functions.
block.timestamp is passed directly as the Uniswap deadline, making swap execution timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is supplied as the liquidity-adding deadline in openTrading, introducing timestamp dependency.
swapTokensForEth invokes the non-view external router swap while the swap is still partially accounted, exposing a callback surface.
The external Uniswap swap can route back into token transfer logic (e.g. via malicious pair/token callbacks) before _transfer finishes.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth before the reflection balances of the current transfer are written, so state is stale during the external call.
_transfer pays out ETH to the fee wallet after swapping but before finalizing balances, enabling reentrant paths.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet, an externally controllable address, after the swap.
If the fee wallet is a contract, receiving ETH can re-enter _transfer before accounting completes.
openTrading performs external factory/router calls (createPair, addLiquidityETH) that can execute attacker-controlled code.
manualswap delegates to swapTokensForEth for the whole contract balance.
manualsend delegates to sendETHToFee for the whole contract ETH balance.
_owner is the value compared against the caller inside onlyOwner, so its integrity directly determines administrative access.
The constructor initializes _owner from the deployer address.
The constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender, granting the deployer full initial control.
transfer routes to _transfer with _msgSender() as the source.
transferFrom routes to _transfer before decrementing the allowance.
transferFrom updates the spender allowance through _approve after the transfer.
approve delegates storage writes to _approve.
balanceOf derives the token balance by converting the reflection balance.
tokenFromReflection needs the current reflection rate.
_transfer finalizes state movement through _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer forwards sender, recipient and amount to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard credits the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard obtains all r/t amounts from _getValues.
_getValues uses getIsBuy to choose between buy and sell tax rates.
_getValues computes token-denominated amounts with _getTValues.
_getValues computes reflection-denominated amounts with _getRValues.
_getTValues performs mul/div percentage arithmetic on the transfer amount, where truncation changes the effective fee.
adjustFees sums buy and sell fee components, relying on arithmetic bounds rather than a hard cap.
_getRate derives the reflection rate from current supplies.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal to compute the supply pair.
getIsBuy exposes the _isBuy direction flag.
_transfer sets the _isBuy flag to steer the tax branch used later by _getValues.
_transfer reads and eventually mutates reflection balances of the involved parties.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to skip limits, blacklists and automatic swaps.
_transfer blocks sells when either party is flagged in the bots mapping.
_transfer distinguishes buys and sells by comparing parties with uniswapV2Pair.
_transfer only performs the automatic swap when swapEnabled is true.
_transfer enforces the buy limit against _maxTxAmount.
_transfer enforces the wallet cap against _maxWalletSize.
_transfer checks inSwap as its reentrancy guard before swapping.

removeLimits resets the wallet cap to the full supply.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the buy-limit enforcement flag.

onlyOwner guards addBot blacklisting.

_takeTeam credits the scaled team amount to the contract reflection balance.
_reflectFee reduces the reflection total supply.
